samaveda_hymn7.introduction: The Jaiminiya or Talavakara Samhita is an important recension of the Samaveda preserved by the school of the sage Jaimini.
samaveda_hymn7.scripture_text: This recension contains many verses and melodies not found in the more widely known Kauthuma and Ranayaniya recensions. It preserves ancient musical traditions that might otherwise have been lost.
samaveda_hymn7.philosophical_explanation: The diversity of Samavedic recensions reflects the rich multiplicity of Vedic musical traditions and the recognition that divine truth can be expressed through many different melodic forms.
